en.p: There is a card with the letter A on its front and the letter B on its back. Using this card and one coin, the following trial is performed.

box: If the number of heads is 2, flip the card over once;
if the number of heads is 0 or 1, leave the card as it is.

en.p: Starting with the card placed so that the letter A shows, after repeating this trial 5 times, the probability that the card is placed so that the letter B shows is $p$. Find the value of $128\times p$. [4 points]
